notes:
Describes matters relating to money in a somewhat formal register. Used when discussing the monetary dimension of a situation, often in contrast to other aspects such as emotional or physical considerations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: financial problem
- {金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧: financial leeway
- {金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧: financial burden
- {金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: financial aid
- {金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: monetary damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧: economic; economical — broader in scope, covering economics generally; also means cost-effective
- {財政的|ざいせいてき}: fiscal — relates to public or organizational finance and budgets
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧: financial — specifically relates to banking, lending, and financial markets

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Common in news, legal contexts, and business discussions. In casual conversation, people more often say ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in terms of money).

definitions.explanation: relating to money or finances; concerning monetary aspects of a matter

examples.japanese: {金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}けない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I can't go on a trip because I don't have the financial means.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金銭的|きんせんてき}な⟦{見返|みかえ}り→見返り：11064_mikaeri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、やりがい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is no financial reward for volunteering, but it is fulfilling.

examples.japanese: {金銭的|きんせんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}する→援助する：26855_enjosuru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to help financially, but I would like to cooperate in another way.
